_comment: Coverage is measured by c8, which reads JSON only. The previous .nycrc.yaml was an nyc
file: c8 silently ignored it (and errors with 'not valid JSON' if pointed at it), so none
of its settings had ever applied. Paths are relative to the repository root, because c8
has no 'cwd' option; that nyc-only key is why an --all run used to sweep in tools/ too.
The excludes below are what c8 already applied by default, written out so they are
visible. The old file also excluded whole packages (node-opcua-types, utils, debug,
nodeset-*, and more). Those are NOT reinstated here: they had never been in force, and
switching them on moves the published figure by about 15 points, which is a decision
about what the number should mean rather than a config repair. Same for thresholds:
c8 defaults --lines to 90, so enabling check-coverage would fail the job immediately.
